summary: First Citizens BancShares filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, disclosing that its wholly owned banking subsidiary, First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company, completed its previously announced acquisition of 138 branches from BMO Bank N.A. effective September 4, 2026. The branches are located across the Midwest, Great Plains and West regions. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1 but provides no purchase price, premium, financing detail or advisor. This is a completed branch acquisition, expanding First Citizens' domestic footprint. Watch for integration costs, deposit retention and regulatory feedback affecting future deals.
